title: Streaming Chat Interface
definition: A chat interface that sends and receives data in real-time, updating the UI on each token.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Streaming chat is like watching a movie in real-time. The interface updates as the AI responds to a query, word by word.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Streaming chat is a design pattern that sends data as it becomes available. In this chat interface, each token of the AI's response is sent separately and displayed in the UI as it arrives.
difficulty_levels.expert: Streaming chat interfaces can enhance user experience by reducing latency. However, they require efficient handling of data streams and can overload networks with frequent updates.

extra_fields.insight: The use of streaming chat in the chat interface enhances the interaction with the AI model, allowing for a more natural and engaging conversation.
